page_title: WOL 2-2 HOF | Wolfsburg v Hoffenheim 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) for his blatant foul.
90+2' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+2' John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+2' Substitution. Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) has come on for Maximilian Beier.
90+2' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

90' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Oliver Baumann easily deals with the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Wolfsburg will have a corner.
89' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
87' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
87' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
86' Here comes a substitution. Andrej Kramaric is given a rest as he is replaced by Bambase Conte (Hoffenheim).
84' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Kevin Behrens is replaced by Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg).

82' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Hoffenheim are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
82' 6:6 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
79' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Florian Badstubner blows for a foul.
78' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) offside.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.
73' Wolfsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
70' 2 - 2 Goal! Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) puts the ball into the top right corner past the outstretched arm of Oliver Baumann.
70' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Florian Badstubner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) is penalised for holding. Florian Badstubner signals a set piece. Wolfsburg have been awarded a penalty kick!
69' The attendance for today's match is 20000.
66' 1 - 2 Goal! Ihlas Bebou plays it to Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Koen Casteels. 1:2.
65' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) replacing Umut Tohumcu.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) comes onto the pitch so that Wout Weghorst can be given a rest.
63' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
62' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

58' 1 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Kevin Behrens picks out an unmarked Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
57' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) has tested the patience of referee Florian Badstubner and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
57' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
56' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Aster Vranckx will be replaced by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
55' Substitution. Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) replaces Joakim Maehle.
51' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim).
48' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Here's the change. Vaclav Cerny leaves the pitch and Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) comes on as a substitute.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Hoffenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+3' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) makes a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
42' The shot by Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Koen Casteels.
40' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
37' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
35' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
32' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
31' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
30' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
27' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.

25' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Koen Casteels easily catches the ball.
23' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Oliver Baumann pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
20' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar.
20' Wolfsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

19' What a chance that is! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the right post!
16' Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
10' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
9' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Rogerio (Wolfsburg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.
7' Rogerio (Wolfsburg) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

6' 0 - 1 GOAL! Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) receives the ball after a swift counter attack. Still with some work to do, he weaves his way through the defence to score a wonderful goal from close range to make it 0:1.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Florian Badstubner is introduced as the referee for today's match.
